title: Philippine economic recovery unlikely until late 2027: Ayala chairman
summary: Economic recovery in the Philippines is unlikely before late 2027 as high energy costs, food inflation and rising interest rates weigh on growth, Ayala Corp Chairman Jaime Augusto Zobel de Ayala said.
